QuestInfo.name: [Pink Bean] Make Mine Ribs!
QuestInfo.0: You need Giant Ribs to lure out the Mini Bean! Bring 1 Developer's Letter to Manager Mush to exchange for 5 Giant Ribs.
QuestInfo.1: Bring 1 Developer's Letter to get 5 Giant Ribs.
QuestInfo.2: You traded 1 Developer's Letter for 5 Giant Ribs.

0.0: Hiya! I'm Manager Mush. Scholarly 'Shroom filled me in about what's going on. You need Giant Ribs for your little Mini Beans, right? Well, I just need one Developer's Letter from Maple World. A letter for ribs! Can't find a deal like that every day!

yes.0: Good. Use the 10th Anniversary festival area to your advantage. Just one Developer's Letter is all you need!

no.0: Welp, you sure give up quick.

1.0: Did you get a Developer's Letter?

yes.0: Check your inventory. I got the Developer's Letter I always wanted, and you got 5 Giant Ribs. Everyone wins!

default.0: No no no. You need a letter! Words on paper! From a developer!
